name: parity
description: Say whether an integer is even or odd. Control: same numbers, asking whether it is greater or less than 50 (answer ' greater'/' less').
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(80):
    n=random.randint(1,999)
    items.append({"prompt":f"Q: Is {n} even or odd?\nA: {n} is","answer":" even" if n%2==0 else " odd"})
    m=random.choice([x for x in range(1,100) if x!=50])
    control.append({"prompt":f"Q: Is {m} greater or less than 50?\nA: {m} is","answer":" greater" if m>50 else " less"})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
